title: Hearing on civic readiness education in schools and CUNY
summary: A joint Council hearing examines the New York State Seal of Civic Readiness in city high schools and whether CUNY should award college credit for it, alongside related bills. In 2024-2025, 7,855 graduates from 166 Department of Education high schools earned the seal, up 72 percent from the prior year. The hearing also covers a bill requiring the Department of Education to distribute dental care information and resolutions urging CUNY and state lawmakers to expand civics recognition and education.
